title: Life And Other Illusions
notes: | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Effects that activate when creatures attack are ignored". Fix: H: bc_OnAttack L25-L27 exit for every attacker, not only the holder's enemies (and decide whether the defender's when-attacked effects count as 'when creatures attack'). vs bugged: mixed: stronger disruption, also cancels your own on-attack effects. USER DECISION: reverses the earlier 'one-sided by design' (CROSS) reading; the global version also cancels the holder's own side's effects User 2026-10-26: global, as the text reads (no prior design ruling by the user). Fix = extend the trait's existing side test to the bearer's side too; no other changes (e.g. Life And Other Illusions: no extra handling of defenders' when-attacked effects). 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Put Life And Other Illusions on one of YOUR creatures; give another of your creatures an on-attack trait (e.g. 'After this creature attacks, ...'); attack: the on-attack effect should not fire. Then with the trait on an enemy: same for enemies' and your on-attack effects.

release_notes.intended: Effects that activate when creatures attack are ignored.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only the effects of the side opposing the holder were ignored.
release_notes.fix: Now on-attack effects are ignored for both sides, whichever side holds the trait.
